Satellite name LabSat (LoCsat, Bio-nanosatellite)
Form factor CubeSat
Units or mass 3U
Status Reentry 2024-09-10. Was semi-operational? (Official post on Twitter about achieving communication from 2022-01-28 but IAC 2022 paper confirmed that experiments could not be carried out due to power and comms issues as of 2022-12-24)
Launched 2022-01-13
NORAD ID 51086
Deployer DPOD / DCUBE [D-Orbit]
Launcher Falcon 9 (Transporter-3) (D-Orbit)
Deployment Deployed from D-Orbit ION on 2022-01-28
Organisation Wroclaw University of Science and Technology
Institution University
Entity Academic / Education
Headquarters Poland
Manufacturer AIVT by SatRev
Operator SatRev
Launch brokerer D-Orbit
Partners Wrocław University of Technology, Medical University, Institute of Immunology and Experimental Therapy, Ludwik Hirszfeld Polish Academy of Sciences and the University of Life Sciences.
Oneliner

Researching the behavior of cancer cells and T lymphocytes, as well as the growth of fungi.
Description

Packed with scientific payloads from Wrocław University of Science and Technology and three other Polish academic institutions.
Researching the behavior of cancer cells and T lymphocytes, as well as the growth of fungi. Miniature laboratory based on MEMS (Micro Electro-Mechanical Systems) technology, which combines micromechanical and microelectronic elements. The CubeSat nanosatellite, which the company will provide, will be equipped with miniaturized lab-on-chip instruments
Results

Unfortunately, due to problems with communication and power supply, the planned biological experiments could not be carried out.
Failure cause Unfortunately, due to problems with communication and power supply, the planned biological experiments could not be carried out.
